item.text: Three neighbors worked together to plant flowers near their local bus stop. One brought a small amount of soil, another contributed seeds they had saved, and the third made a simple sign for the new planting. Their effort was modest, but it added a little color to the area beside the bench. Later, a passerby quietly supported the project by leaving a watering can nearby, giving the neighbors an easy way to care for the flowers as they grew.
